name: Trust Territory of Somaliland
alt: Trust Territory of Somaliland under Italian Administration

predecessors.name: British Africa
predecessors.text: former Italian Somaliland under the British Military Administration: 'The British continued to administer the area until 1 April 1950'

predecessors.name: Italian Africa
predecessors.text: Italian Somaliland, the colony occupied by British and South African troops in 1941

successors.name: Federal Republic of Somalia
successors.text: 'On July 1, 1960, the two territories united as planned to form the Somali Republic'

ledger.x: 1 April 1950: Italy returns to Mogadishu as UN trustee.
1 July 1960: the trust territory joins British Somaliland in the Somali Republic.
1 July 1960: the Italian trusteeship ends in union and independence.

certainty.note: The trust territory's frontiers with Ethiopia and British Somaliland were colonial-era lines the opened pages do not describe; the Ethiopian frontier was a standing UN question in 1954 (title in the page's references).
